```python
import simpa as sp
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import os

# Set up global simulation parameters
VOLUME_WIDTH_MM = 30
VOLUME_HEIGHT_MM = 30
VOLUME_DEPTH_MM = 10
SPACING_MM = 0.5
WAVELENGTHS = [700, 730, 760, 800, 850, 900]  # in nm

SIMULATION_PATH = "simpa_tissue_simulation"
os.makedirs(SIMULATION_PATH, exist_ok=True)

# Define global settings
settings = sp.Settings()
settings[sp.Tags.SIMULATION_PATH] = SIMULATION_PATH
settings[sp.Tags.VOLUME_NAME] = "tissue_volume"
settings[sp.Tags.WAVELENGTHS] = WAVELENGTHS
settings[sp.Tags.SPACING_MM] = SPACING_MM
settings[sp.Tags.DIM_VOLUME_X_MM] = VOLUME_WIDTH_MM
settings[sp.Tags.DIM_VOLUME_Y_MM] = VOLUME_HEIGHT_MM
settings[sp.Tags.DIM_VOLUME_Z_MM] = VOLUME_DEPTH_MM
settings[sp.Tags.ILLUMINATION_TYPE] = sp.Tags.ILLUMINATION_TYPE_PENCIL_BEAM
settings[sp.Tags.OPTICAL_MODEL] = sp.Tags.OPTICAL_MODEL_MC
settings[sp.Tags.ACOUSTIC_MODEL] = sp.Tags.ACOUSTIC_MODEL_LINEAR
settings[sp.Tags.DEVICE] = sp.PhotoacousticDevice()
settings[sp.Tags.ILLUMINATION_GEOMETRY] = sp.PencilBeamIlluminationGeometry([VOLUME_WIDTH_MM/2, VOLUME_HEIGHT_MM/2, 0])

# Function to create the tissue structure
def create_tissue_structure():
    structures = []

    # Background
    background = sp.define_background_structure_settings(
        molecular_composition=sp.TissueLibrary.water()
    )
    structures.append(background)

    # Muscle layer
    muscle_layer = sp.define_horizontal_layer_structure_settings(
        name="muscle",
        z_start_mm=2,
        thickness_mm=6,
        molecular_composition=sp.TissueLibrary.muscle()
    )
    structures.append(muscle_layer)

    # Epidermis layer
    epidermis_layer = sp.define_horizontal_layer_structure_settings(
        name="epidermis",
        z_start_mm=0,
        thickness_mm=0.2,
        molecular_composition=sp.TissueLibrary.epidermis()
    )
    structures.append(epidermis_layer)

    # Blood vessel 1
    vessel1 = sp.define_elliptical_tubular_structure_settings(
        name="blood_vessel_1",
        a_mm=1.0,
        b_mm=0.5,
        z_start_mm=3.0,
        z_end_mm=7.0,
        x_center_mm=10.0,
        y_center_mm=15.0,
        molecular_composition=sp.TissueLibrary.blood(oxygenation=0.9)
    )
    structures.append(vessel1)

    # Blood vessel 2
    vessel2 = sp.define_elliptical_tubular_structure_settings(
        name="blood_vessel_2",
        a_mm=0.8,
        b_mm=0.4,
        z_start_mm=4.0,
        z_end_mm=8.0,
        x_center_mm=20.0,
        y_center_mm=10.0,
        molecular_composition=sp.TissueLibrary.blood(oxygenation=0.6)
    )
    structures.append(vessel2)

    return structures

# Add tissue structure to settings
settings.set_volume_creation_settings({
    sp.Tags.STRUCTURES: create_tissue_structure()
})

# Run the simulation
sp.simulate(settings)

# Linear unmixing
unmixing_settings = sp.Settings(settings)
unmixing_settings[sp.Tags.SIMULATION_PATH] = SIMULATION_PATH
unmixing_settings[sp.Tags.VOLUME_NAME] = "tissue_volume"
unmixing_settings[sp.Tags.WAVELENGTHS] = WAVELENGTHS
unmixing_settings[sp.Tags.LINEAR_UNMIXING_ALGORITHM] = "standard"
unmixing_settings[sp.Tags.UNMIXING_CHANNELS] = ["oxyhemoglobin", "deoxyhemoglobin", "water", "melanin"]

sp.MultispectralProcessingAlgorithm(unmixing_settings).run()

# Load and visualize results
def visualize_results():
    # Load initial pressure for each wavelength
    for wl in WAVELENGTHS:
        ip = sp.load_data_field(SIMULATION_PATH, "tissue_volume", sp.Tags.DATA_FIELD_INITIAL_PRESSURE, wavelength=wl)
        plt.figure()
        plt.imshow(ip[:, :, int(ip.shape[2] / 2)], cmap='hot')
        plt.title(f'Initial Pressure at {wl} nm')
        plt.colorbar()
        plt.show()

    # Load and visualize linear unmixing results
    for chrom in ["oxyhemoglobin", "deoxyhemoglobin", "water", "melanin"]:
        unmixed = sp.load_data_field(SIMULATION_PATH, "tissue_volume", f"LINEAR_UNMIXING_{chrom}")
        plt.figure()
        plt.imshow(unmixed[:, :, int(unmixed.shape[2] / 2)], cmap='hot')
        plt.title(f'Linear Unmixing: {chrom}')
        plt.colorbar()
        plt.show()

visualize_results()
```
